package.name: revohuman_ros
package.description: Thin ROS2 wrapper around the RevoHuman glove SDK: glove_node (single hand) / bimanual_node (two hands merged). Exposes only data topics and four manually triggered services; Tracker poses are published from the same node (enabled with the tracker_mode parameter); the wrist camera, as optional hardware, is likewise embedded in the node (enabled with the camera_mode parameter, default off).
